sections.label: Reports, major research papers and theses (graduate studies)

items.topic: Last day to submit a thesis for written evaluation and receive a 100% financial credit (applies only if you are enrolled exclusively in the thesis and were also enrolled in the thesis in the previous term). If you receive a 100% financial credit, your enrolment for the current term will be cancelled. Credit is not applicable if you are submitting a revised thesis. Note that students awaiting written evaluation of their thesis must remain enrolled in UHIP until the end of their program.

Last day to submit a thesis for written evaluation and receive a 50% financial credit (applies only if you are enrolled exclusively in the thesis and were also enrolled in the thesis in the previous session). Credit not applicable if you are submitting a revised thesis. Note that students awaiting written evaluation of their thesis must remain enrolled in UHIP until the end of their program.

Last day of the Winter term to submit the engineering report without having to enrol in the Spring-Summer term. The deadline for submitting the engineering reports may be earlier in some programs. Please confirm the date with your academic unit.
Last day of the Winter term to submit the major research paper. The deadline for submitting the major research paper may be earlier in some programs. Please confirm the date with your academic unit.
